content.text: Milo crawling into your bed at 5 is really common, and it usually fades with a calm, boring routine. Tonight, tell him the plan at bedtime: "You sleep in your bed, and if you come to us, we'll walk you right back." Then do exactly that every time. Keep it quiet and short, with no chat and no negotiating. A little reward the next morning for staying put, like a sticker, helps it stick.
